_comment: Registered parameters. Hashed into every run manifest.
STATUS MUST BE 'registered' BEFORE ANY ATTRIBUTION NUMBER IS COMPUTED:
the changepoint fallback condition is part of the primary rule's
definition, so choosing it after seeing results would make the rule
outcome-dependent. E0 is sanity-only and does not read a decision here.
changepoint_min_seg: shortest admissible regime, in steps.
changepoint_min_contrast: below this contrast the split is noise, and the
changepoint_boundary_fallback: when true, a split landing at the first or
last admissible position is treated as isolating an endpoint rather than
finding a regime, and falls back to argmin.
max_degenerate_cells: how many (subset x type) cells may be constant,
saturated, or near-binary before E0 calls the field unusable.
